title: Smoke Apparitions
description: A dark silhouetted male figure is shown from the chest up, exhaling a swirling mass of luminous white and pale purple smoke that forms ghostly faces and abstract shapes. The figure is positioned against a nearly black background with faint floating color fragments and a horizontal light bar across the lower portion of the frame.
prompt: A dark silhouetted man exhaling swirling luminous smoke that morphs into multiple ghostly human faces and abstract forms, the smoke is pale purple and white, dramatic side lighting on his shoulder and head, deep black background with faint floating color fragments, painterly brushwork, moody and surreal atmosphere, dark tones
